abilities.critical_failure: The creature takes full damage, 2d8 persistent electricity damage, and becomes deafened for 1 minute.
abilities.effect: The abbot's spirit appears and begins to channel powerful ki energy. One round later, the room fills with a powerful kinetic storm, dealing 3d10+15 electricity damage and 3d10+15 force damage to all creatures in the room. Creatures in the room must attempt a DC 37 Reflex save.
abilities.failure: The creature takes full damage and becomes deafened for 1 round.
abilities.name: Ki Storm
abilities.trigger: A creature enters the prayer room

hazard.description: A monk's tormented spirit attacks intruders.
hazard.disable: DC 32 Irori Lore (trained) to clean the room and return the prayer items to their proper arrangement, DC 37 Religion (expert) to state an Iroran prayer of peace and put the haunt to rest, or DC 40 Occultism (master) to create a ward against future hauntings
hazard.name: Wronged Monk's Wrath
hazard.reset: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't re-form if a creature lights all of the candles in the room and offers a prayer to Irori.

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
